label: Bible Study
prompt: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be _____,
verse: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
note: A mystery revealed — not everyone will die, but everyone will be changed.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy _____: this is the first commandment.
verse: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.
note: Jesus calls this the first commandment: love God with everything — heart, soul, mind, and strength.

label: Sunday School
prompt: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an _____ to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
verse: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
note: Noah built the ark after being warned of 'things not seen as yet' — faith in a forecast nobody else believed.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not _____ against it.
verse: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
note: Spoken at Caesarea Philippi right after Peter's confession — Jesus pictures hell on defense, gates and all.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the _____ of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;
verse: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;
note: 'Sleight' as in sleight of hand — trickery, not 'slight.' Paul warns against doctrine dealt by card sharps.
